notes.title: New music, new friends, new stories, new... ending?
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I want to start by saying thank you to everyone who has played this game. This game was created from the bottom of my heart and the passion I have for games. Despite my limited knowledge in many areas of game development, my heart, dreams, and determination  guided me to create this game, and I am incredibly happy with the results because I didn't expect anything in the first place! Just a single person who has liked my game fills me with happiness. Bringing a feeling, a dream, or a thought into something tangible, like a video game, is a beautiful feeling. The art of creating reminds me of my humanity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If you have been part of this little experiment, thank you, from the bottom of my heart! <3[/b][/p][p][/p][p]With that being said, I'm happy to share some news![/p][p][b]No Happy Days is getting a content update later this year![/b][/p][p]I have been planning this update for a while, and I cannot wait to make this new dream come true and bring even more adventures to this game! There will be new areas in the Ribbit Island, new fun NPCs to interact with, even more music, and a fun secret minigame! This update will expand further the world of No Happy Days and have a feature some people were asking for... [b]a new ending![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I'll be sharing more updates as development goes here, as community posts in Steam, so please make sure to follow and check around here regularly! I have a cool idea to do with you guys, and I'm sure you won't want to miss it![/p][p][/p][p][i]Hint: How would you like to create an NPC for a game? [/i](>ᴗ•)[/p][p][/p][p]With that being said, please look forward to hearing from me again soon. In the meantime, please, keep being a kind human![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p][p][/p][p]-Piero Ramirez[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220873/b5631b6bebc9d2f653ed73ed4fc3f59d0a64e897.png"][/img][/p]
